claim_boundary: This theorem is restricted to the generic ell=2,k=0 local-gauge-reduced block. It does not include exceptional/global tangents, general ell, opposite momentum, all-orders integration, final residual states, causal propagation, particles, or quantum theory.
domain: finite real generic ell=2,k=0 Weyl-Maxwell tangents with all m, both axial and polar parities, Einstein-plus/minus and both extra polarizations, satisfying total H=J_1=J_2=J_3=0
interpretation: At ell=2,k=0 the nonlinear tangent cone is exactly as large as the stabilizer moment-map test permits at second order. Pure axial and pure polar sources contribute the known H and J_i obstructions, including cancellations between parities, while every axial-polar cross source lands in an invertible quotient block. No additional quadratic condition survives.
next_gate: test whether the source-rank and resonance argument persists for symbolic ell, then retain opposite-momentum relative phases

nonzero_frequency_descent.cross_parity_blocks: all nine types are off every polar L1,L3 and axial L2,L4 shell
nonzero_frequency_descent.pure_same_parity_blocks: all nine types are off shell by the shared same-parity ledger used in both pure cone theorems
nonzero_frequency_descent.relative_phases: arbitrary constant phases are retained; invertibility is coefficient-independent

obstruction_descent.axial_L1: the pure-sector physical adjoint pairings add to total mu_Ji and cancel when total J_i=0
obstruction_descent.complete_static_condition: total H=J_1=J_2=J_3=0; P_x vanishes identically at k=0
obstruction_descent.cross_terms: no physical adjoint cokernel in any zero-frequency cross-output block
obstruction_descent.moment_map_cross_terms: zero by orientation-preserving parity and the direct-current harmonic decomposition
obstruction_descent.scalar_L0: the axial and polar rank-one source columns share (1,0,1/2,0); their coefficients add to the total mu_H and cancel when total H=0

quadratic_decomposition.axial_polar_cross_output: odd total parity: polar odd-L and axial even-L; axial L0 absent
quadratic_decomposition.axial_self_output: even total parity: polar even-L and axial odd-L
quadratic_decomposition.polar_self_output: even total parity: polar even-L and axial odd-L

second_order_solution.construction: project the total exact source by output L, parity, and frequency; use total H,J cancellation in the only physical zero cokernels and invert every remaining quotient block; lift through the target Noether identities
second_order_solution.temporal_class: finite quasiperiodic plus any zero-frequency polynomial/Jordan correction selected by the axial L1 solve
